title: Block Git Commands in Script Interpreters
summary: Fixed background click deselection when panning is enabled. setPointerCapture in handlePointerDown suppresses the subsequent click event, so handleSvgClick never fires. Moved the deselect-on-background-click logic into handlePointerEnd — when no drag occurred (didPanDragRef is false), clearSelection is called. Also kept the previous fix: replaced useEffect-based initial selection with useState initializer across all algorithm stories to prevent re-triggering.
